summary: BUG-0094: adopt Core-master pool membership and repository observations in the disposable Controller projection, and limit member VM placement to fresh Core-reported NFS/SMB access. API impact: changed Core inventory contract; Controller neither owns membership or repository state nor reconciles members.

guide.reason: The pool-join and storage guides describe Core-master membership and the observed-access conditions for member placement.

api.reason: Managed inventory now carries Core-owned membership and per-member repository access observations used for Controller adoption and placement preflight.

roadmap.reason: This bug-fix slice does not change the published Phase 4 scope or acceptance status.

state.reason: Membership, master repository configuration and member access observations are Core state. Controller stores only a replaceable report projection.
state.record: The pool master's pool-peer membership and pool-storage records are reported through managed inventory; a replacement Controller re-adopts the same pool, repository identities and member observations from the master report.

verification.method: Ran focused Controller adoption/placement regressions and the UI build. Native multi-host reconciliation and disposable-lab acceptance remain pending the Core owner and are not claimed here.
